parrafo.es: Guillermo the Barber es la silla de Guillermo Pineda en un pequeño local de sillas compartidas en Kendall, sobre SW 104th St, Miami, FL. Con más de 20 años de experiencia, corta fade, arregla barba y hace afeitado con toalla caliente, con la misma atención al detalle en cada cita. Se reserva en Booksy o dejando un mensaje de voz fuera de horario.
parrafo.en: Guillermo the Barber is Guillermo Pineda's chair inside a small shared-chair suite in Kendall, on SW 104th St, Miami, FL. With over 20 years of experience, he handles fades, beard work and hot towel shaves, with the same attention to detail at every visit. Book on Booksy or leave a voicemail outside business hours.

parrafo_1.es: Guillermo Pineda lleva más de 20 años detrás de la tijera y la navaja. Guillermo the Barber es su silla propia dentro de un pequeño local de sillas compartidas en Kendall, sobre SW 104th St, en Miami, FL. Él mismo atiende cada cita: fade, barba, afeitado con toalla caliente y más, sin prisa y con el mismo cuidado corte tras corte.
parrafo_1.en: Guillermo Pineda has spent more than 20 years behind the clippers and the razor. Guillermo the Barber is his own chair inside a small shared-chair suite in Kendall, on SW 104th St, Miami, FL. He handles every appointment himself: fades, beard work, hot towel shaves and more, without rushing and with the same care cut after cut.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes lo describen igual una y otra vez en Booksy: un barbero de la vieja escuela, con atención al detalle que se nota en cada línea y cada fade. 4.9 de calificación en 69 reseñas en Booksy, con clientes que reservan con él desde hace años y otros que ya llevan a sus hijos a la misma silla.
parrafo_2.en: Clients describe him the same way over and over on Booksy: an old school barber, with attention to detail that shows in every line and every fade. A 4.9 rating across 69 reviews on Booksy, with clients who have booked with him for years and others who now bring their sons to the same chair.

items.quote: Exceptional attention to detail on the beard line-up. He managed a sharp, symmetrical finish without over-lining or compromising the natural shape. The fade is seamless, and the straight-razor shave was executed with zero irritation. If you value technical precision over small talk, this is the spot.
Best barber in Miami! My man is an artist with the clippers. Great attention to detail, monster fades.
Incredibly talented old school barber! Impeccable attention to detail and outstanding customer service.
I've been cutting my hair with Guille for a few years now. He is a true pro! He takes his time and his attention to detail is impeccable. Highly recommend!

Professional, courteous, a great sense of integrity and high standard of morals. Within the last 12 months I've recommended all three generations of my family to have their hair cut at this establishment.
